status: source-grounded draft; not a runnable action contract
source: AGC 2019 official ReadMe and Hemming et al. 2020, Sensors 20(22):6430, section 2.2

feed_ec.mechanism: team request implemented through staff and central fertigation system

screens.polarity_evidence: Calibration-only internal check: when external PAR >100 and the other screen <10, high blackout position has much lower processed natural PAR than low position; high energy position reduces processed natural PAR from about 0.50 to about 0.38 of outdoor PAR. Tot_PAR is itself calculated using screen position, so this checks coding semantics, not independent optical transmission.
screens.greenlight_closure_proxy: observed percentage divided by 100; formal use still needs actual product optical/thermal properties

lighting.hardware_interlock: LED lamps only powered when HPS lamps are on
lighting.blank_led_vip: unknown unless physical HPS-off interlock applies; VIP is not measured photon output

co2_dosing.evidence: sum(co2_dos)/12 matches same-source daily CO2_cons kg/m2/day over 107 complete calibration days per compartment; this is not independent flow validation

interpretation: Historical control rights and available observations are distinct from new benchmark capabilities; no unverified direct action is enabled.
